review_candidates.description: Description Title: Senior Manager, Project Controls Department: Operational Excellence Location: Houston, TX Supervisor: VP of Project Controls FLSA Status: Exempt Position Status: Full-Time Work Status: Remote SENIOR MANAGER, PROJECT CONTROLS Hanwha Qcells USA Corp (Qcells USA), headquartered in Houston, TX, specializes in providing utility-scale modules, solar photovoltaic (PV), and battery energy storage systems (BESS) project development, along with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services for solar and BESS projects nationwide. Qcells USA delivers comprehensive turnkey solutions encompassing the entire utility-scale project lifecycle. By choosing Qcells USA for turnkey solutions, customers can reduce uncertainty and risk, leading to enhanced investment returns and contributing to a more sustainable future. Qcells USA’s complete turnkey solutions seamlessly integrate the expertise of our Development, Module, and EPC teams, while ensuring close coordination with other vital internal groups such as Project Finance, Systems Integration, and Legal. This collaborative approach ensures that Qcells USA projects deliver exceptional value and performance. With several multi-billion-dollar investments, Qcells is pioneering the establishment of the only complete module supply chain in the U.S., including the expansion of our Georgia module manufacturing facility, which stands as the largest in the Western Hemisphere. As an integral part of the global Qcells brand, Qcells USA benefits from a legacy of excellence in photovoltaic manufacturing. Qcells is renowned worldwide for its high-performance, superior-quality solar cells and modules. With dual headquarters in Seoul, South Korea (Global Executive HQ) and Thalheim, Germany (Technology & Innovation HQ), Qcells operates under the umbrella of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 company and one of the top 8 business conglomerates in South Korea. Summary The Senior Manager of Project Controls will drive the commercial success of our utility scale solar and BESS projects. This role will directly manage a dedicated team of Commercial Managers and Project Accountants, focusing on the financial and contractual aspects of Self-Perform Solar Projects. The ideal candidate will be passionate about renewable energy, possess strong communication and influential skills, and have a proven track record in project management, experience in construction cost control, cost forecasting, CPM scheduling, negotiation skills, risk and opportunity identification and management, change management, and contract management. The role requires constant evaluation of both internal resources and subcontractor contributions to the projects' success, addressing any contractual issues rapidly to maintain project momentum. The successful candidate will have regular collaboration with the internal Project Controls team, construction management senior leaders, and operations teams to implement tools and processes throughout the active construction projects. This position reports to the VP of Project Controls, or another senior management personnel that the CEO of the Company may designate. This position is remote, working out of your home and traveling to the jobsites. Working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00am to 5:00pm or 9:00am to 6:00pm. This position requires to travel up to 25% of the time. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Essential Job Function & Responsibilities Lead a team of Commercial Managers and Project Accountants, overseeing their work on Self-Perform Solar Projects. Collaborate with project directors, project managers, and construction managers to meet project objectives within constraints. Participate as a key stakeholder in negotiations for subcontracts, ensuring favorable terms and compliance with company standards. Oversee and conduct comprehensive assessments to identify project risks and opportunities, devising strategies to mitigate risks while capitalizing on opportunities. Oversee and manage change orders, ensuring they are accurately documented, assessed for impact, and implemented effectively for upstream and downstream commitments. Develop and implement strategies to ensure all projects adhere to contractual obligations and company policies. Regularly evaluate internal resource and subcontractor performance to guarantee adherence to project execution strategies. Address and resolve any upstream or downstream contractual disputes or issues promptly to minimize the impact on project timelines and budgets. Prepare and present detailed monthly executive reports, including variance analysis, risk logs, project summary reports, forecasts, and change logs. Conduct weekly and monthly reviews of deliverables for project management, providing constructive feedback and development plans to enhance team performance and capabilities. Implement and maintain project cost control plans and procedures. Partake as a key stakeholder in project schedule development and review, including critical path management and progress tracking. Manage project budgets, including cost tracking and forecasting. Engage with clients and stakeholders to align expectations with project goals and communicate invoicing, cash flows, and change management. Ensure all projects are compliant with the business’ set standards in reporting and project management means and methods. Perform other duties and special projects, as assigned by Senior Management. Regular attendance, in accordance with company's attendance policy and supervisory assignment, is an essential job duty requirement for this position. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in related field; MBA preferred, or 5+ years work experience in a related field. At least 2 years of experience in project management, or a cost control function, preferably within the renewable energy sector. Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple tasks and deadlines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project management software, and other relevant tools Have insight to highlight key risk factors and advise EPC cost estimates. Experience with current solar EPC tools and processes and remain current on best practices and trends in the industry. Demonstrated track record of initiating programs that lead to significant cost reduction and/or performance improvement. Capability to interact with leadership cross-culturally, both within and outside the organization Have both a long-term strategic perspective and near-term action orientation, and a strong desire to continuously improve and push limits. Strong team player with a high degree of professionalism in which one conducts self at all times. Willingness to travel as required, up to 25%. Esta Posição Reporta Para IS Manager __ In this role, you will co-own our SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud unit as a single value stream, leading everything non-finance — supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, procurement, and sales / order-to-cash — end to end. This is a fully accountable owner's seat on a clean-core, fast-moving environment with one mandate: run this unit as fast and as AI-automated as possible. You will own the operational outcome together with one equal peer who leads finance; there is no hand-off to a support team, and no hierarchy between you. The work model for the role is: Hybrid This role is contributing to the Installation Products Division of the Electrification business area in Europe. Main stakeholders are operations and supply chain, the Finance co-owner, and the central platform team You Will Be Mainly Accountable For Co-owning the unit as one value stream and owning the non-finance operations end-to-end — run as connected flows (source-to-pay, plan-to-produce, order-to-deliver), not module silos — with full accountability for a single shared outcome alongside the Finance co-owner. Driving AI adoption at scale and stretching automation to its limit — beginning with test and regression automation against the continuous Public Cloud release cadence, then automating the operational flows themselves, deploying AI only where it moves a real metric. Running the unit fast and lean — assessing every S/4 Public Cloud release for fit and new functionality, adopting what adds value while keeping the core clean, and drawing on the central team's Developer, Integration, and Reporting services to deliver (directing and consuming them, not duplicating them). Co-owning the cross-functional seams with the Finance owner — order-to-cash and procure-to-pay run across both of you — so the end-to-end flow holds and nothing falls between operations and finance. Our team dynamics You will join a small, senior, high-ownership team — two equal co-owners running one unit — where you will be able to thrive. Qualifications For The Role A BS degree in engineering or a related technical field is a preferred. You have hands-on SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud experience — not Private, not ECC alone. You know the clean-core model, the release cadence, and what the Public Cloud will and will not allow. (This is a hard requirement.) You are driven to adopt AI at scale and push automation — test automation first — to its absolute limit; you treat a clean, fast-moving unit as a place to find the ceiling of what can run with no manual effort, not to hold a steady state. You are highly skilled across the non-finance value chain — MM, PP, IM, LE/WM, SD, QM — and you think in end-to-end flows (source-to-pay, plan-to-produce, order-to-deliver), not isolated module configuration. You have a demonstrated track record of extreme ownership — owning an outcome end to end (build and run) — and you can share a single outcome with an equal peer without building turf. You are passionate about learning and intellectually honest — comfortable with ambiguity, quick to say "I don't know" or "I was wrong," and curious enough to outpace your own defensiveness. You are at ease communicating in English; an additional European language is a plus. A degree in engineering or a related technical field is a plus. You hold a valid work authorization for the European market What's in it for you? This is a rare mandate: a fully accountable owner's seat on a modern Public Cloud unit with a single, sharp goal — run it as fast and as AI-automated as possible. You'll have the autonomy to drive AI adoption at scale and take automation as far as it will go, on a clean core built to be pushed. If your drive is to find the ceiling of what AI and automation can run — not to hold a steady state — this is the seat. review_candidates.description: PS Job Title: Project Manager, Sr Lead - CP Work Place Flexibility: Onsite Legal Entity: Entergy Services, LLC While this position's preferred location is New Orleans, LA, we are open to qualified candidates from across Entergy's service territories in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas.** The selected candidate for this role will be placed as a Project Manager, Sr Lead or Project Manager, Sr Staff based on education, experience, and demonstrated success at the Project Manger level.** Job Summary/Purpose Project Manager, Sr Lead CP or Sr Staff CP Large Project Services develops projects and serves as primary project interface for all large block load/revenue additions to Entergy’s System, including new facility construction and expansion of existing facilities. Promotes safe behaviors and adherence to Entergy Safety Rules and OSHA guidelines. Accountable for system wide Operating Company support to Economic Development and Industrial Accounts teams by developing timely and cost effective engineering solutions required to create attractive customer business solutions and aggressively grow Entergy’s business. Leads collaboration across multiple business units as needed to ensure customer solution sets are optimized to satisfy cost, scope, and schedule constraints. Coordination includes, but is not limited to, Entergy Economic Development, Industrial Accounts, Transmission and Distribution Planning, Transmission & Distribution Engineering, Transmission & Distribution Operations, Transmission & Distribution Finance and Entergy Legal. Accountable for completion of the following Stage Gate 0 & 1 deliverables: Requests for Information (RFI) and Class 5 estimates originating from internal stakeholders regarding distribution and transmission system capacity to serve, interconnection upgrades needed, and system upgrades needed to serve block load additions. Deliverables typically include, but not limited to, overall scope of work description, drawings, cost estimate, and estimated duration to execute. Supports Entergy’s Economic Development and Industrial Accounts teams in the initiation of Class 3 Facilities Studies with the appropriate Power Delivery Project Management team, including being responsible for the setup and management of appropriate internal accounting strings. Works with Entergy accounting, legal and Project Delivery to ensure reimbursable projects are appropriately contracted, financed, and recovered, targeting zero stranded costs. Ensures compliance with approved policies and procedures. Candidate must be self-directive and proven self-starter. Job Duties/Responsibilities Project Manager, Sr Lead CP or Sr Staff CP Promotes safe behavior and adherence to the safety rules on the project. Receive and review project development request from internal Entergy stakeholders and verify block load addition details. Initiate and receive appropriate level planning study from Entergy Transmission, Distribution, and/or Resource Planning. Collaborate with Planning teams to identify optimal solutions. Develop appropriate level of deliverable document to convey the necessary Entergy project scope, cost estimate and execution duration to support the block load addition interconnection to Entergy’s transmission and/or distribution system. Provide peer check support to rest of Large Project Services Team. Develops project cash flows that aligns with project schedule and cost estimates with check provided during other internal stakeholder’s engagements. Maintains clear, timely and accurate project status reports and identifies, communicates, and takes prompt actions for project issues that may impact project performance. Ensures proper documentation and archiving for all work, ensuring appropriate Record Retention documentation is maintained. Ensures high quality handover with Project Delivery Project Management for developed projects. Works with Miscellaneous Accounts Receivable, Project Controls, and Portfolio Management to ensure projects are properly accounted for, including both Entergy and Customer funded projects. Works with Entergy legal representation to ensure sound contracting with Customers. Works with internal stakeholders to ensure project details are properly maintained in Entergy CRM tool and provides additional support during internal meetings to review CRM entries. Regularly participates in cross-functional training and process improvement initiatives and serves as a mentor within the Project Development organization. Minimum Requirements Minimum Education Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field OR 4 years of equivalent/related work experience (in addition to Minimum Experience requirement) in lieu of degree. Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering. Preferred: Advanced Degree (Masters in Engineering, Construction, Project Management). Minimum Experience Project Manager, Sr Lead: 6+ years of experience in Project Management, Construction Management, Electric Utility Industry, or related field. Project Manager, Sr Staff: 8 years of experience in Project Management, Construction Management, Electric Utility Industry, or related field. Minimum Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Expert in project and construction management fundamentals. Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology to transmission lines and substations.
